text:
Priya: Short PR to centralize 'call patterns' (compact envelopes + examples) into one landing page. Need quick passes on multi-lang snippets and a 1-line migration shim. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/999
Noah: Nice. Please include a tiny Go example showing nil-list normalization.
Priya: Will do. Also adding a note for legacy parsers that check `tool.name` and `tool.arguments`.
Diego: For TS samples let's use the `client.invokeTool()` wrapper and show `const items = resp.items ?? []` to avoid null asserts.
lint-bot: Reminder: code blocks require captions and captions must be present for all languages.
Noah: I'll add Ruby and Go captions. For Ruby show `items = resp['items'] || []` and call out `nil` vs `[]`.
Priya: Added a tiny migration shim snippet and a redirect table for old anchors. Pushed.
Diego: I'll run local build and click anchors; sending smoke results in ~10m.
lint-bot: Snippet linter: one failure -> missing caption in Python block.
Priya: Fixed caption, re-pushed.
lint-bot: CI: PR #999 snippet tests passed, docs build OK.
Noah: Recommend adding an anchor-check CI grep test in a follow-up PR to prevent future 404s.
Priya: Agreed, opening follow-up. Thanks team!
